articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-horizon planning tasks and multi-step mathematical proofs, narrowing the gap with domain-specific expert systems. Enterprise API availability rolled out alongside a revised pricing tier that undercuts GPT-4o by roughly 40% per token at equivalent capability thresholds.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which set new records on GPQA-Diamond, MATH-500, and a newly introduced molecular dynamics simulation benchmark. The model integrates a retrieval-augmented generation layer trained on over 200 million peer-reviewed papers, enabling it to propose novel hypotheses that were independently validated in two chemistry labs. Google is positioning the model as a core component of its Vertex AI research assistant suite for pharmaceutical and materials science customers.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in three of its Gigafactory facilities, performing bin-picking, parts transport, and quality-inspection tasks alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature a new 23-DOF hand with tactile feedback sensors and improved gait stability from a redesigned actuator stack. Tesla reported a 35% increase in manipulation dexterity over Gen 2, with plans to offer leased units to third-party manufacturers by Q4 2026.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform for Construction
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, backed by Hyundai, announced the commercial launch of the Atlas platform tailored for construction environments, featuring autonomous rebar carrying, site surveying, and stair navigation under load. The fully electric humanoid uses a transformer-based world model trained on thousands of hours of construction site data to plan routes and avoid hazards in unstructured terrain. Pilot programs with Bechtel and Skanska are scheduled to begin across six sites in the United States and South Korea this summer.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Guardrails Standard Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published an open specification for constitutional AI guardrails that has been formally adopted by the EU AI Office as a reference framework for compliance with the EU AI Act's high-risk system requirements. The specification includes auditable reward model constraints, interpretable chain-of-thought filtering, and real-time bias detection hooks. Several major cloud providers including AWS and Azure have announced native integration support, potentially making it a de facto industry standard for safe AI deployment.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Fab 20 in Tainan, approximately one quarter ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction compared to N2, with backside power delivery and gate-all-around nanosheet transistors at tighter pitches. Apple and Nvidia are expected to be lead customers, with first consumer silicon anticipated in early 2027 product cycles.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Record Fidelity
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly reported achieving below-threshold error rates on logical qubit operations using a hybrid trapped-ion and topological error-correction scheme, reaching logical error rates of 10⁻⁸ per operation across 12 logical qubits. This milestone represents a critical step toward commercially viable quantum computation for optimization problems in logistics and drug discovery. The team published a roadmap targeting 100 logical qubits by late 2027, which would enable quantum advantage on select industrial workloads.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by SoftBank Vision Fund and joined by Intel Capital and Samsung, valuing the company at approximately $12 billion. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid manufacturing facility in Texas and expand its Figure 02 robot's deployment from BMW's Spartanburg plant to additional automotive and logistics partners. The company also announced a partnership with OpenAI to integrate next-generation vision-language-action models directly into the robot's on-board inference stack.
